scope: CPU API baseline only; not deployment, GPU, transport, whole-frame or E5 acceptance
processStatistic: Two-sided 95% Student-t interval of mean paired log(P95 ratio), n=3, df=2, t=4.302652729911275. Require every run and interval upper bound <= threshold. Interval crossing threshold = unproven. Assumes independent process pairs; no frame-level pseudo-replication.
continuation: If noisy, preserve all 3 pairs; preregister a separate additional cohort before running it. Never select best runs or merge incompatible schedules.
